description: Key terms of a commercial property lease. Base every value on the document text — never infer a term it does not state, and never substitute a market-standard default. Use null (or an empty array) wherever the document is silent: null is a correct answer, an invented value is not. A document answering a field with "N/A", "None" or similar is stating absence — return null, never the literal text. Dates as ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Money as a plain number, with no symbol or thousands separator.

name.description: Building or property name ("Harbor Ridge Business Centre"). Null when only a street address identifies the premises.

address.description: Municipal address of the leased premises on one line, including unit, city, province or state and postal code. The premises being let — not the landlord's own business address.

suite.description: Suite or unit identifier alone ("310", "Unit 12"), without the street address.

type.description: Premises type. Take it from an explicit premises-type field; if only a permitted use is given, classify from that.

size.description: Rentable area in square feet, as a plain number — the area rent is calculated on.

landlord_name.description: Legal name of the landlord, including any entity suffix. The owner, not the property manager.

tenant_legal_name.description: Legal name of the tenant, including any entity suffix.

tenant_contact_name.description: Named individual contact for the tenant, with their title if given.

tenant_contact_email.description: Tenant contact email address, exactly as written.

tenant_contact_phone.description: Tenant contact telephone number, exactly as written.

start_date.description: Commencement date of the term. Use the explicit term commencement where the document gives one, otherwise the possession date. Never the signing date.

expiry_date.description: Expiry date of the initial term.

term_years.description: Length of the initial term in years, as stated ("7-year Term"). Do not compute it from the dates.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for every amount in this record (CAD, USD). Infer from the jurisdiction or an unambiguous symbol; null if genuinely unclear.

base_rent_rate_per_sf.description: First-year base rent rate per square foot. Where a schedule escalates, this is lease year 1.

base_rent_annual.description: First-year annual base rent, as stated. Do not compute it from rate x area.

rent_schedule.description: The base rent schedule, one entry per lease year or rate step, in document order. Empty array when rent is flat. Nested, so its values are not individually cited — the top-level rent fields are.

rate_per_sf.description: Rate per square foot for this period.

annual_rent.description: Annual base rent for this period.

operating_costs_estimate_per_sf.description: Estimated operating costs per square foot. Null on a gross lease where the tenant pays none.

security_deposit.description: Security deposit amount. Null if none is required.

permitted_use.description: What the tenant may use the premises for, including any express exclusions ("no retail sales to the public").

tenant_insurance.description: Insurance the tenant must carry, with coverage types and minimum limits as stated.

assignment_and_sublease.description: Whether the tenant may assign or sublet, whose consent is needed, and any carve-out.

tenant_maintenance.description: What the tenant must maintain or repair.

renewal_options.description: Renewal options: how many, how long, how the rate is set, and the notice required. Null if none granted.

holdover_terms.description: What applies if the tenant stays past expiry — the holdover rent and the tenancy it creates.

governing_law.description: The province, state or jurisdiction whose law governs, only where a governing-law clause says so. Do not infer it from the address.
